changelog:
- Operates OpenCage through an OOMOL-connected account using the `oo` CLI, with credentials injected server-side.
- Supports forward geocoding from addresses or place names to OpenCage results.
- Supports reverse geocoding from latitude/longitude coordinates to place data.
- Can return geocoding results as GeoJSON `FeatureCollection` output.
- Guides agents to inspect live connector schemas before running actions and to handle first-time setup only after auth or connection failures.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@146ef20`
